<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion is at m/z 182.073165, which matches the exact mass of C₁₃H₁₀O. The ¹H NMR shows a single aromatic multiplet integrating to 10 H, consistent with a molecule containing two equivalent phenyl rings attached to a carbonyl (benzophenone). The SMILES for benzophenone is “O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2”.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2</final_answer>
